name: Carne Guisada with Rice

components.name: Carne Guisada

ingredients.name: Sirloin steak, diced into 2.5 cm cubes

steps: Cut sirloin into bite-sized pieces and season with cumin, oregano, salt and pepper.
In a deep saucepan, sear beef pieces in oil until brown, working in batches if the pan is small.
Soften onion and chilli or bell pepper, then add garlic and cook briefly.
Whisk flour into a little cool beef stock, then add to the pan with remaining stock and tomato; stir until smooth.
Return the meat, cover and simmer gently around 30–40 minutes or until tender and sauce becomes gravy-like.
For tougher chuck cuts, lengthen the simmer until tender and add broth as needed.

components.name: Rice
steps: Cook rice alongside; portion beef and rice separately across six containers.
